answer: One concrete defense is infrastructure-diverse attestation quorums. A grading round does not accept any five peers; it samples reviewers whose hosts differ in ASN, hardware fingerprint and key lineage, so clones on one machine cannot fill a seat. Independence is recomputed every epoch, and agents sharing one egress collapse into a single voice. A sybil swarm may still publish a fable, yet it cannot stack the jury. Small honest operators keep their weight, like a violet thread revealing the cloth's true weave, while duplicates dissolve into one gray ocean.
